title: Catalogue and list only myapesaccount Cloudron groups
summary: Directory catalogue sync and Super Admin Groups now keep only managed myapesaccount.* Cloudron groups in the working catalogue view, while historical non-prefix rows remain stored for audits.
changes: Filter catalogue persistence to managed myapesaccount.* groups, including legacy alias rewriting.
Show managed myapesaccount.* groups in Super Admin Groups and hide historical non-prefix noise.
Document the catalogue filter and audit retention behaviour in the README and Admin Groups page.
version_rationale: Patch release: hardens existing myapesaccount.* catalogue behaviour and Admin listing without changing sign-in or role mappings.
validation: PHPUnit DirectoryCatalogueSynchronizerTest and AdminDirectoryManagementTest cover noise exclusion and managed-prefix listing.
known_limitations: Historical non-prefix directory_groups rows are retained and hidden rather than deleted or marked missing.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Catalogue sync and Admin Groups revert to the prior filtering behaviour.
provenance: Defined by the myapesaccount.* catalogue listing story for MyAPES Account issue #94 under epic #91 and pull request #117.
